bias.zh: 下跌趋势 · 守住 200 日均线，受制于 $158

read.en: Palantir edged up 0.1% on Nov 18 to $156.67, trading $153.50–158.44 on light volume (0.60x the 20-day average). It is below the 5-day ($162.6) and 10-day ($163.9), both falling, the 100-day ($168.1) and the falling 30-day ($184.5), and above the rising 200-day ($153.8). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 16, below zero, histogram steady; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Nov 17 ($174.98), and RSI is 33.0.
read.zh: Palantir 11月18日微涨 0.1%，收于 $156.67，盘中区间 $153.50–158.44，成交量偏低（为 20 日均量的 0.60 倍）。股价位于下行的 5 日（$162.6）和 10 日均线（$163.9）、100 日均线（$168.1）及下行的 30 日均线（$184.5）下方，位于上行的 200 日均线（$153.8）上方。MACD 自 10月16日起位于信号线下方，在零轴下方，柱状图平稳；抛物线 SAR 自 11月17日起看空（$174.98），RSI 为 33.0。

read.en: The $153.50 low dipped under the 200-day and the Nov 17 low intraday, but the close held above both, while the $158.44 high was capped at $157.2–158.7. Resistance is $157.2–158.7, then $160.4–162.6 and $162.6–168.1 (5, 10 and 100-day). Support is $153.5–153.9 (200-day, Nov 17–18 lows), then $152.6 (Nov 5 low) and $150. A close above $158.7 would target $160–163; below $152.6, $150.
